# Executive KPIs

Trend, growth and seasonality for `mart_kpi_monthly`.
KPIs are ratios — averages are re-computed from numerators and denominators,
never by averaging the ratio column.

## MoM / YoY growth (txn_amount)

```{r}
#| echo: false
g <- read_table("kpi_growth_txn_amount")
if (!is.null(g)) print(utils::tail(g, 24)) else cat("No growth table in this run.\n")
```

## Seasonal profile

Mean value and share of annual total per calendar month.

```{r}
#| echo: false
sp <- read_table("kpi_seasonal_txn_amount")
if (!is.null(sp)) print(sp) else cat("No seasonal profile in this run.\n")
```

## Process control

Individuals chart limits for `txn_amount` are written by the `monitoring` step
to `tables/control_chart_kpi.csv`. Points outside 3σ are special-cause signals.

```{r}
#| echo: false
cc <- read_table("control_chart_kpi")
if (!is.null(cc)) {
  flagged <- cc[cc$out_of_control, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(flagged)) print(flagged) else cat("No out-of-control points.\n")
} else {
  cat("No control-chart table in this run.\n")
}
```

## Variance bridge

`kpi_variance_bridge()` decomposes a KPI move into volume / mix / rate effects
for a waterfall chart. See `R/mart_kpi_monthly.R`.
